rv.q: This production is cathartic for even the most patriotically jaded of us.
Its unique, globally renowned work is built on stepping — a propulsive, percussive dance form that turns performers’ whole-body stomps, claps, slaps, and shoutouts into enthralling storytelling.
In its world premiere at Arena Stage, "The Fruits of Our Labor" offers an exhilarating evening of entertainment while holding strong to the notion that history is everyone's to be interpreted...

cn.t: Step Afrika!'s world premiere dazzles with awe-inspiring physicality and soul-stirring rhythms, offering an exhilarating celebration that powerfully honors the nation's 250th anniversary through the language of dance.
